messages:
alex: Starting catalog enable for model `azurewing-13b-quant-v2` in the next change window (2026-04-01 06:00-09:00 PST). Canary plan: 1% -> 10% (30m) -> 50% (1h) -> 100%. Priority: traffic->region routing preserved. Observability runbook at https://go/internal/runbooks/catalog-enable.

deploy-bot: kicked off canary group `canary-eu-1` at 3467891250. image: registry/redwood/azurewing:13b-q-v2. status: provisioning GPUs.

maya: thanks. quick checks: are we pinning previous `azurewing-13b-fp16-v1` for enterprise customers? we had 2 enterprise rollbacks last month.

alex: yes — enterprise customers on reserved capacity will be pinned to `azurewing-13b-fp16-v1` by default via catalog.pin list for 72h. We only flip for those accounts if SLS approves.

liam: ops notes — rollback triggers we agreed: error_rate >= 2% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency increase > 30% over baseline for 10m OR model token hallucination score regression (eval set) > 5%. If triggered, system will failover to fallback chain (see below) and alert on-call.

ops-bot: inserting fallback ordering into catalog: ["mantis-13b-fp16-v2", "mantis-13b-quant-v1", "azurewing-13b-fp16-v1"]. Confirm?

maya: prefer mantis-13b-fp16-v2 as first fallback. confirmed. also enable lightweight prefix caching for first 3 tokens to reduce cold-start p95.

alex: rollout knobs to monitor: token throughput, p50/p95 latency, 5xx/4xx ratios, decode_throughput, embed/recall mismatch rate. If any spike happens at canary -> pause and run safety drain.

deploy-bot: canary-eu-1 ready. traffic routed 1% (eu only). telemetry pipeline has started ingest: aggregator job id aggr-7788.

liam: added deck of quick remediation commands in thread:
```
# drain canary
rbacctl catalog rollback --model azurewing-13b-quant-v2 --to mantis-13b-fp16-v2 --reason "auto-drain"
# pin enterprise
catalogctl pin --account <acct-id> --model azurewing-13b-fp16-v1 --ttl 72h
```

sara: heads-up: QA observed slightly higher repetition on long-form prompts in playbook tests at 10% traffic (small sample). Not a full block but flagging. test logs -> https://go/internal/logs/xyz

alex: noted. ramp to 10% on hold for 15m while we validate sample sizes. Maya, can you run the eval harness on the 10 canonical prompts (quick set)?

maya: running now. will post results in ~12m.

ops-bot: monitoring hooks: latency_alerts (p95, 30m windows), error_rate_alerts (5m), quality_regressions (eval-run). All wired to #eng-oncall and s-resp.

deploy-bot: canary traffic paused at 1% due to hold flag by alex. scheduled resume candidate at 3467891900 unless blocked.

maya: eval results: 10 canonical prompts show minor BLEU drop on 2/10, hallucination score up by 1.8% (below rollback threshold). Recommendation: continue rollout but enable stricter sampling temperature for chat endpoints (0.85 -> 0.8) in canary only.

alex: agreed. patching canary sampling override now.

deploy-bot: sampling override applied to canary-eu-1. config snippet:
```
{ "sampling": { "temperature": 0.8 }, "overrides": ["canary-eu-1"] }
```

liam: reminder: post-cutover tasks: update catalog ChangeLog entry, add per-route latency baselines, and run 2h smoke on reserved pools. I'll take reserved pool smoke.

alex: timeline update: if health remains stable at 10% for 40m, we plan 50% ramp. if stable at 50% for 60m, schedule 100% at end of window. Otherwise we'll pin rollout and open rollback incident.

sara: adding a release-note blurb for marketing and support: short description + known QA note about repetition on long prompts. will post to /release-notes draft channel.

deploy-bot: canary-eu-1 metrics: p95 +4%, error_rate 0.6%, hallucination metric +1.2%. No auto-triggered rollback.

alex: proceeding to 10% then 50% per plan unless anything else. if on-call sees noise, call immediate halt. :thumbsup:
